measures.counts_what: residents who were not U.S. citizens at birth, including those who have since naturalised
measures.out_of: all residents of the place
measures.concept: Nativity
measures.definition_note: Foreign-born residents as a percentage of all residents.
universe_published: Total population
caveats: People born in Puerto Rico and other U.S. island areas are native-born, not foreign-born, and are counted in B05002 'Native; born outside the United States'.
A birthplace count is a stock: how many residents were born in that place. It is not a count of recent arrivals and says nothing about when or whether a person moved to the place shown.

measures.label: Share born in another U.S. state
measures.counts_what: residents born in a different U.S. state
measures.out_of: all residents of the place

measures.label: Naturalised share of foreign-born residents

universe_published: Total population
caveats: Naturalization depends on length of residence and eligibility; a low share can reflect recent arrival, eligibility rules, or both.
